name: Kurenaino Aria
source:
A black magic proxy who is said to place curses on others, provided she has a sample of the victim's hair and information. She runs her shop in Hamonika-Yokochou (harmonica alley) near Kichijouji Station. Her real name is Ria Minase.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Occultic;Nine]Wikipedia[/url]]
